description: This file handles processing and preparing Slack message content, including filtering files, resolving media attachments, and constructing message bodies for display or further processing.

methods.name: filterInheritedParentFiles
methods.description: Filters out inherited parent files from a Slack thread reply based on thread starter information.

methods.name: resolveSlackMessageContent
methods.description: Asynchronously constructs the content of a Slack message, including media and text, for display or processing.
